title: SaveMyDiskToolSet
description: Universal Tool & Function Calling definitions for AI Agents (WorkBuddy, Cursor, AutoGen, CrewAI, LangChain, etc.)

function.name: audit_drives
function.description: Performs non-invasive read-only scan of fixed disk volumes, system hotspots ($WINDOWS.~BT, SoftwareDistribution, Docker vhdx), and top AppData directories. Outputs structured JSON.

json.description: Return structured JSON output instead of console text.

function.name: scan_app_residues
function.description: Scans for uninstalled Steam game leftover directories, empty/corrupt software directories, NVIDIA driver OTA caches, and safe-to-clean office/chat caches (WPS, WeChat, QQ, Feishu, DingTalk). Generates .save-my-disk/cleanup_manifest.md.

function.name: scan_dev_artifacts
function.description: Scans for inactive/zombie build outputs (node_modules, target, .vs, build) from projects untouched for at least days_inactive (default 60 days). Source code is preserved.

scan_path.description: Optional custom workspace path to scan.

days_inactive.description: Minimum days of inactivity required to qualify. Default 60.

function.name: scan_ai_models
function.description: Scans for local AI and machine learning model caches including Hugging Face Hub (blobs without symlink double counting), Ollama GGUF models, and PyTorch checkpoints. Injects findings into cleanup_manifest.md.

function.name: scan_package_caches
function.description: Scans for global developer package manager caches: pip wheel cache, npm offline tarballs, Conda pkg tarballs and unpacked pkgs, and Gradle caches. Injects findings into cleanup_manifest.md.

function.name: manage_wsl_disk
function.description: Analyzes WSL2 and Docker Desktop virtual disk (.vhdx) sizes and optionally compacts them using diskpart after shutting down WSL.

force.description: Execute actual compaction after user confirmation.

function.name: clean_selected_residues
function.description: Safely cleans confirmed residue IDs (SYS-xxx, RES-xxx, DEV-xxx, AI-xxx, PKG-xxx, IM-xxx, BRW-xxx) or reads approved checkboxes from the manifest file. Requires explicit user confirmation. Runs in dry-run mode unless force is true.

from_manifest.description: Read approved '- [x]' items directly from cleanup_manifest.md.

force.description: Must be set to true to execute actual deletion after user confirmation.

function.name: clean_windows_update
function.description: Safely purges Windows Update download cache and obsolete backups. Must be run with Administrator privileges after user confirmation.

function.name: scan_im_office_residues
function.description: Scans for domestic IM & office application caches (WeChat 3.x/4.0, WXWork, QQ, Feishu, DingTalk). Distinguishes media playback caches (Tier 3) from historic received files (Tier 2) and strictly shields all chat history databases (*.db).

days_inactive.description: Threshold in days for identifying inactive historic received documents. Defaults to 90.

function.name: scan_browser_system_caches
function.description: Scans for safe-to-clean browser caches (Chrome, Edge, Brave Code Cache & GPUCache, Firefox cache2), GPU/DirectX shader caches (D3DSCache, NVIDIA DXCache/GLCache), and crash dumps. Strictly shields login credentials and history.

function.name: export_dashboard
function.description: Generates a zero-dependency, standalone HTML visual dashboard (.save-my-disk/disk_triage_report.html) summarizing disk space allocation, 4-tier risk categories, and cleaned vs pending items.

output_path.description: Path to write the standalone HTML report.

open.description: Whether to automatically open the report in the default browser.

function.name: verify_health
function.description: Verifies post-cleanup volume free space and Windows Update service operational health. Optionally regenerates visual HTML dashboard.

export_html.description: Whether to regenerate the visual HTML dashboard.
